trigger: Ryo is knocked out in a duel (demo default; later variants by row reached and winning yokai, S3)
title: Ryo is defeated
text: {yokai} slips off between the lanterns, tails swaying, and does not look back. Somewhere a bound thing is still waiting for someone to return it.
speaker: narrator
notes: Replaces the HUD placeholders 'Ryo is defeated' / 'The yokai slips free.' Demo text with yokai = Kitsune: 'Kitsune slips off between the lanterns, tails swaying, and does not look back. Somewhere a bound thing is still waiting for someone to return it.'
